rec_texts: Proceedings to hear Cause Bro Confesso.
Another mode of proceeding, when the defendant elects
not to answer, is to procure the cause to be set down to
be heard as if the defendant had confessed the truth of the
matter in the Bill stated. This is done under the provisions-
At the expiration of the time allowed to any defendant-
dant within the jurisdiction of the Court for answering
the bill or at any time within three weeks afterwards, the
plaintiff may cause such defendant to be served, person-
ally, or by his solicitor (if he have one), with a notice of
motion to take motion, to be made on some day not less three weeks
after the day of such service, that the bill may be taken
pro confesso against such defendant; and thereupon, un-
less such defendant shall in the mean time have put in his...
answer to the bill, or obtained further time to answer the
same, the Court, if it shall think fit, may order the bill to
be taken pro confesso against such defendant, either im--
immediately, or at such time and upon such terms and sub--
ject to such conditions as under the circumstances of the
case the Court shall think proper.
